title: Mini pages
description: A card is a tiny page: its data is one line in this file, its url is real, and there is no folder for it anywhere on disk.

card.title: First steps
card.body: The first card — default ground, one paragraph. Its whole existence is the one line in page.jsonl that made it.

card.title: The decision
card.body: A light gray card. Reload this exact url and you land right back here, because the data this page reads from is still the same file, every time.

card.title: Going deep
card.body: A dark card, read the same way as the other two. Three cards, one file, zero folders below this page.
